title: Veyra player settings registry
description: Every player setting the Settings screen offers (Settings & Accessibility Bible; ADR-024 §2): its category and store, when it may change, and its kind, bounds and default. Presentation data, never gameplay truth: the server does not read it and it is outside the tuning hash.

provenance.description: Where the default and bounds come from (ADR-008 §7): Canon when the bible states them, Provisional for League's answers (ADR-024 §9).

scope.description: Which store keeps it (Settings Bible §7): Device, local to this machine, or Account, synced to the player's account.

availability.description: Whether it may change in a live match (Settings Bible §6.2): Anywhere, or OutsideMatches.

applies.description: When a change takes effect (Settings Bible §6.3): AtOnce, or AfterRestart.

settingId.description: A setting's ID, a content ID.

option.description: A choice's option, as the code that applies it spells it.

minimum.description: The lowest value the slider offers.

maximum.description: The highest value the slider offers; above the minimum.

step.description: The slider's step; the default lies on a step from the minimum.

default.description: Within the bounds, on a step.

options.description: Each option, once, in the order the screen offers them.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

toggles.description: Settings that are On or Off, by setting ID.

ranges.description: Settings on a slider, by setting ID.

choices.description: Settings that take one of several options, by setting ID.

layout.description: The Settings screen's categories in the order it shows them, each with its settings in order (Settings Bible §13). Only categories with settings appear (ADR-024 §5): every setting is listed once, in its own category's section.
